title: Accounting SAP End User Course for experienced
heroTitle: Struggling to Return to Your Core Accounting Career? We Guide You Back.
heroDescription: Are you a B.Com, MBA (Finance) or accounting graduate working in a different domain? SV Professionals transforms your profile with real-time experience, SAP training & placement support - so you can walk into an MNC with confidence.
eligibility: Open to B.Com / B.Com (Hons), MBA - Finance, M.Com, BBA - Finance, CA Inter / CMA Inter, or any Accounting Background Graduate.

methodology.label: Learning Approach
methodology.title: Learn → Practice → Perform
methodology.desc: Our three-phase model ensures you don't just learn theory - you simulate real corporate workflows before you even attend your first interview.

steps.title: Learn
steps.desc: Conceptual training by industry practitioners covering AP, AR, P2P, O2C, R2R, Fixed Assets, Inter-Company Accounting, and SAP Fi end-user navigation - aligned to current MNC workflows.

steps.title: Practice
steps.desc: Hands-on simulations in SAP, Advanced Excel, and Tally. Real business transaction scenarios mirroring what top companies use - you practise on live-like systems, not slides.

steps.title: Perform
steps.desc: Mock interviews, technical rounds, resume workshops, and placement drives. By the time you sit for an interview, you've already "done the job" in our simulated environment.

highlights.desc: Entry to mid-level MNC placements across top global GCCs and shared services.

faqs.q: Who is this program designed for?
faqs.a: This program is exclusively for graduates with an Accounting & Finance background - B.Com, M.Com, MBA (Finance), BBA (Finance), CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent.

faqs.q: Do I need prior SAP experience?
faqs.a: Absolutely not. We start SAP training from scratch. Our end-user level SAP Fi training is designed for beginners and progressively moves into real-time corporate simulations.

faqs.q: What does "100% Placement Support" mean exactly?
faqs.a: It means we stay with you until you're placed. This includes profile building, resume crafting, interview preparation (technical + HR), and direct connections to our hiring partners.

faqs.q: Is this suitable if I have a career gap?
faqs.a: Yes - in fact, most of our students come with career gaps ranging from 1 to 5 years. Our program specifically addresses how to position your gap positively and present a credible, job-ready profile.

faqs.q: What salary can I expect after the program?
faqs.a: Depending on your experience, location, and the company, our graduates typically secure roles in the ₹3.5-8 LPA range. Entry-level roles start around ₹3.5-5 LPA.
We offer flexible batch timings including weekday morning and evening batches, so working professionals can enroll without disrupting other commitments.

faqs.q: Will I get a certificate after completion?
faqs.a: Yes. Upon successful completion of the program, you will receive an industry-recognised course completion certificate from SV Professionals.

faqs.q: How is this different from online YouTube tutorials?
faqs.a: We offer live, interactive sessions with industry practitioners, access to real SAP systems for hands-on practice, personalised feedback, mock interviews, and an active placement network.
